title: Good-representative coherent reduction/pullback adjunct
statement: Let the notation and hypotheses be as in the Lean declaration below. Good-representative coherent reduction/pullback adjunct holds.

source.place: Tags 07A6, 08TC and 0941; the representative/localization steps of the parent proof.

proof.text: Use the normalized finitePullComparison and ordinaryAmbientPullIso to construct the cochain isomorphism from finite scalar reduction of ordinary pullback to finite pullback of the scalar reduction. Apply the ordinary module adjunction to compare its scalar unit with the specified quotient augmentation: naturality moves the scalar unit through ordinaryAmbientPullIso, and the two generator normalization equations agree.

On a good complex, ordinaryIntegralPullComplexCounit is invertible and ordinary pullback is K-flat. The normalized finite scalar counit model and its unit equation identify the finite adjunct of the completion projection with the composite of that counit, finite scalar reduction, and the cochain isomorphism of step 1. The completion chain projects to the quotient augmentation by the mapping-cocone lift and product projection equations. Thus this finite adjunct is invertible.

Construct finiteOutput by applying evaluation to the good reduction model, the exact sequence inverse-image localization factors, inverse-image evaluation, and the ordinary finite reduction evaluation. The prescribed integral pullback realization, normalized Roos projection, strict pullback tower components, and exact restriction factors show that the projection of the published pullback model followed by restriction of finiteOutput is the strict finite Roos projection.

Take the natural adjoint mate of pullComparison followed by the integral pullback model. The counit projection equation identifies each finite evaluation, after the finiteOutput isomorphism and reduction evaluation, with scalar extension of pullIso followed by the invertible adjunct of step 2. Finite evaluations are conservative, so the mate is invertible on every good representative. Fully faithful precomposition with the good localization reflects this natural isomorphism globally. The hom-set adjunction unit formula gives the required equation, in fact at every object.

proof_origin.place: Finite quotient scalar-unit normalization, conservative finite evaluation, and full faithfulness of good localization; no new split obligations.

lean.statement:
theorem pullbackReductionAugmentation_good {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    ∃ a : PurCompactSupport.pull (PurCompactSupport.completed l E) f ⋙
        (pullbackTensorCalculus l E X).reduction ≅
      (pullbackTensorCalculus l E Y).reduction ⋙ pullbackTensorSequenceDerived l E f,
      ∀ P : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).FullSubcategory,
        (pullComparison l E f).app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj) ≫
            (pullbackTensorIntegralPullbackModel l E f).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj) =
          (pullbackTensorCalculus l E X).adjunction.unit.app
              ((PurCompactSupport.pull (PurCompactSupport.completed l E) f).obj
                (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj)) ≫
            (coefficientSequenceLimit l E X).map
              (a.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj))
